stem: From the description of Mr. Moffatt's library, the reader can infer that he —

options.label: A
options.text: has many intellectual interests and a strong hunger for knowledge

options.label: B
options.text: is more interested in displaying his wealth than in reading or writing

options.label: C
options.text: earns his living working in his library and rarely ventures out of it

options.label: D
options.text: is proud of his ancestors' contributions to science and literature
